metadata.rule: No binding sale, listing, §1031 commitment, or lease renewal/extension may be executed until Gates 0 through 4 are verified with offline advisor sign-off.

gates.publicStatus: Framework Ready — Private Vault Required Offline
gates.blockingItems: Establish access-controlled offline internal folder (encrypted drive / advisor data room) for APN, deed, executed lease, tax returns, and debt docs. Confirm NDAs before sharing confidential data with brokers.
gates.exitCriteria: All PII & parcel records isolated offline; public dashboard contains zero identifiers.

gates.phase: Gate 1 · Private Lease Abstract & Notice Calendar Reconciliation
gates.blockingItems: Abstract exact legal tenant/guarantor (Corporate vs. Franchisee), fee vs. ground lease, exact expiration date (2030–2035), rent & escalations, percentage rent, Prop 13 reassessment pass-through, option rent formula, ROFR/ROFO, casualty/EQ clauses, and hard notice deadlines.
gates.exitCriteria: Signed attorney lease abstract reconciled against an audited Notice Calendar with 36/24/18/12-month milestone triggers.

gates.phase: Gate 2 · W-01 Trade-Area Geocoding & W-04 Parcel Hazard / Engineering Screening
gates.ownerRole: Owner / Land-Use Consultant / Environmental Engineer / Insurance Broker
gates.publicStatus: BLOCKED — Requires Confidential APN Offline Lookup
gates.blockingItems: Confirm City of LA vs. adjacent jurisdiction (Measure ULA applicability); pull 1/3/5-mi Census tracts (2015–19 vs. 2020–24), ZIMAS zoning/TOC/AB 2011 eligibility, arterial AADT, nearby LAUSD schools & QSR competitors; run CGS EQ Zapp, FEMA MSC, CAL FIRE 2025 LRA FHSZ; review tenant COI & order Phase I ESA / PCA.
gates.exitCriteria: Verified offline parcel profile replacing all regional proxies and confirming environmental, seismic, flood, fire, and insurance insurability.
gates.sourceLabel: CGS EQ Zapp, CAL FIRE 2025 LRA & LA Finance ULA

gates.phase: Gate 3 · Tenant Credit, Store-Level Sales & 'JACK on Track' Exposure Check
gates.publicStatus: Public SEC Series Verified through Q3 FY26 — Store Sales & FY26 10-K Pending
gates.blockingItems: Verify subject store annual sales, sales trend since AB 1228 ($20/hr wage), rent-to-sales ratio, and franchisee financials (if applicable); monitor Jack in the Box FY2026 Form 10-K (pending as of Nov 25, 2026) and post-turnover leadership strategy.
gates.exitCriteria: Quantified store-level rent coverage and renewal likelihood vs. block-closure risk.

gates.phase: Gate 4 · W-02 Short-Lease BOV Quotes, CPA After-Tax Computation & Model Back-Test
gates.ownerRole: CPA + 3 Independent SoCal NNN Brokers + Land Broker
gates.publicStatus: BLOCKED — Requires Real Broker BOVs & Private Tax Basis
gates.blockingItems: Obtain 3 written BOVs pricing BOTH current WALT and extended 10–15 yr WALT + unencumbered vacant land value; obtain CPA verified adjusted basis, CPA-determined unrecaptured §1250 gain component, CA/Federal rates, Measure ULA impact, and §1031 vs. Prop 19 estate comparison; run & back-test versioned W-02 model.
gates.exitCriteria: Audited, apples-to-apples after-tax Net Present Value & wealth-risk comparison across Sell Taxable, Sell §1031, Early Renewal/Blend-and-Extend, and Hold-to-Expiry.
gates.sourceLabel: IRS Form 8824, IRS Topic 409, CA FTB & U.S. Treasury

gates.phase: Gate 5 · W-10 Advisor Alignment & Binding Strategic Commitment
gates.publicStatus: NOT READY — Winner Deliberately Withheld Until Gates 1–4 Close
gates.blockingItems: Convene joint advisor review using W-10 One-Page Summary + offline W-02 verified model outputs; stress-test BAU & Black Swan outcomes (loss of rent + repairs + exit liquidity together); execute chosen path (negotiate renewal, market for sale/§1031, or prepare re-tenanting/redevelopment).
gates.exitCriteria: Documented, risk-balanced decision aligned with owner's wealth preservation, liquidity, and growth objectives.
gates.sourceLabel: CA BOE Prop 19 & USGS UCERF3 Risk Framework
